en.description:
Dunk Gravity is a physics-based basketball arcade game designed exclusively for Apple Watch.
Use the Digital Crown to aim left or right. Tap the screen to launch. Watch the ball arc through the air, bounce off the rim, and — if your aim is true — swish through the net.
Every shot matters. You have 3 lives. Miss the hoop and you lose one. Score a dunk and keep going. Chain consecutive dunks to build streak bonuses and climb your personal best.

GAMEPLAY
Rotate the Digital Crown to aim your shot direction
Tap to launch with real physics-powered trajectory
Score through the hoop to earn points
Chain dunks for streak multiplier bonuses
3 lives per game — make every shot count

FEATURES
Real physics engine with gravity, bounces, and rim collision
Digital Crown precision aiming
Haptic feedback on rim hits, backboard contact, and swish
Animated score popups and neon visual effects
Persistent high score and best streak tracking
No ads. No in-app purchases. Just you and the hoop.

DESIGNED FOR APPLE WATCH
Built from the ground up for watchOS. No iPhone required. Play a quick round during a break, on a commute, or whenever you have 30 seconds and want to beat your best.
How many dunks can you chain?
en.subtitle: Physics Hoops on Your Pocket
